about.summary: The University of California, San Francisco is a public land-grant research university in San Francisco, California, United States. It is part of the University of California system and is dedicated entirely to health science and life science. It conducts research and teaching in medical and biological sciences.

documents.title: Data and Analytics Governance at UCSF
documents.summary: UCSF's Data and Analytics Governance program aims to promote responsible data management, privacy, and data-driven decision-making. The program emphasizes literacy, integrity, and culture while providing a framework for managing data processes in alignment with UCSF’s mission. It focuses on committee structures, business stewardship, data compliance, data management, reporting governance, and training and education.

documents.title: Strategic Plan | UCSF School of Medicine
documents.summary: The UCSF School of Medicine's strategic plan outlines a commitment to advancing health globally by prioritizing education, research, healthcare, and public service. It identifies seven thematic areas, including opportunity, belonging, and anti-discrimination, with specific tactics prioritized to achieve the school's future vision. The plan will be finalized and implemented in 2025 following stakeholder engagement and refinement of tactics.
